zones.name: Finster Library - 2nd Floor
zones.description: Quiet study area with individual cubicles and high-speed Wi-Fi. Perfect for deep focus.
zones.howToGetThere: Enter Finster Building, take the elevator or stairs to the 2nd floor, turn left past the reception.

zones.name: Arrupe Hall CR - Ground Floor
zones.description: Well-maintained restrooms with handicap access. Usually clean and less crowded.
zones.howToGetThere: Located at the back of the ground floor, near the southern exit.

zones.name: Jubilee Hall Lounge
zones.description: Open-air lounge area where students gather between classes. Great for group discussions.
zones.howToGetThere: Central area of Jubilee Hall, easily accessible from the main walkway.

zones.name: Martin Hall Cafeteria
zones.description: Main campus cafeteria serving a variety of meals and snacks. Student-friendly prices.
zones.howToGetThere: Located on the first floor of Martin Hall, facing the basketball courts.

zones.name: Registrar's Office
zones.description: Official office for student records, enrollment, and certifications.
zones.howToGetThere: Ground floor of Finster Building, main entrance, right-hand side.
